desc:
CEREAL: Real Reese's peanut butter and Hershey's cocoa collide on sweet crunchy corn puffs

FUN KIDS BREAKFAST IDEA: Quick, easy and option for your kid’s breakfast; add milk and you're good to go

KID’S SNACK: Enjoy by itself for an after school snack or on-the-go

WHOLE GRAIN: Made with 15 grams of whole grain per serving (at least 48 grams recommended daily)
features:
Features

Bold Chocolate-Peanut Butter Flavor

Delivers the classic Reese’s candy flavor in a crunchy cereal form — a favorite among kids and adults alike

Whole Grain Goodness

Contains 15g of whole grain per serving to support a heart-healthy diet.

Fortified with Nutrients

Includes a blend of vitamins and minerals to help support overall nutrition

Versatile Use

Can be enjoyed with milk, eaten dry as a snack, or used as a crunchy topping for desserts and yogurt.

Quick and Easy Breakfast

No prep required — perfect for busy mornings or as a grab-and-go cereal.

Benefits

Satisfies Sweet Cravings

A great option for those who love sweet, dessert-style cereals without diving into candy.

Kid-Friendly & Fun

Appealing flavor, vibrant packaging, and crunchy texture make it a hit among kids.

Balanced with Whole Grains

Despite being sweet, it provides whole grains and some nutritional value to start the day.

Snack-Ready Anytime

Works well as an afternoon snack or treat — not just for breakfast.

Trusted Brand Quality

Backed by General Mills, a leading name in cereals with consistent taste and standards.
